title: Adversarial Agent Policy Configuration
description: Defines how findings are evaluated against policy thresholds to produce a pass/fail verdict.

policyVersion.description: Semantic version of this policy configuration.

failThresholds.description: Thresholds that trigger a FAIL verdict.

blockingFindingsMinimum.description: Any finding with severity=BLOCKING and confidence=HIGH will trigger FAIL if count >= this threshold.

advisoryFindingsMaximumWhenBlocking.description: When blockingFindingsMinimum is met, advisory findings are still counted but do not independently trigger FAIL.

errorIsFailure.description: If true, an ERROR verdict (review could not complete) triggers FAIL.

allowedAgents.description: Whitelist of agent names allowed to contribute verdicts. Other agents are ignored.

agentQuorum.description: Minimum number of independent agents required to have run before accepting the verdict. 0 disables this check.

verdictCombination.description: How multiple agent verdicts are combined: ANY (single FAIL triggers overall FAIL), ALL (all must FAIL).

evaluationMode.description: STRICT (enforce policy immediately), ADVISORY (log but don't block), or DISABLED.

requiredFinding.description: If set, at least one finding matching these criteria must be present for FAIL verdict to take effect.

auditCategories.description: Per-category audit configuration for tracking and trending.

enabled.description: Whether this category is actively monitored.

alertOnCount.description: Alert operators if this category appears more than N times in a single review.

excludeEdgeCases.description: Patterns or file paths to exclude from review (e.g., generated code, test fixtures).

executionDefaults.description: Defaults applied to agent execution if not specified in individual agent config.

retryAttempts.description: Number of retries on transient failure.

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens the model can use for a single review.

notificationSettings.description: How failures are communicated to developers.

commentOnFail.description: Post a PR comment when verdict is FAIL.

failureCheckNamePrefix.description: GitHub Checks API name prefix for this gate.
